description: Estimates the additional costs of buying a property in Germany (Kaufnebenkosten): real estate transfer tax of the federal state, notary and land register as a usual range, and the buyer's commission. Pass a listing_id from search_listings to use its price, postal code and commission, or pass price and state. An estimate, not tax or legal advice.

commission_percent.description: Buyer's commission in percent of the price, if any.

listing_id.description: A listing for sale from search_listings; fills price, state and commission.

plz.description: Five-digit postal code, used to derive the state if state is missing.

state.description: German federal state, code or name, e.g. NW, Bayern.

name: calculate_purchase_costs

bundesland_aus_plz.description: true = state derived from the postal code; ask the user to confirm.

grunderwerbsteuer.description: Real estate transfer tax of the state.

hinweis.description: Estimate, no tax, legal or financing advice. Tell the user.

notar_grundbuch.description: Notary and land register as a usual range.

objekt_link.description: Listing page, if a listing was given.

partner_link.description: Optional page on objelio.de where the user can send a request to an Objelio partner (financing or short valuation), marked as a partner offer. Mention it only if the user asks about financing or valuation; never collect contact data in the chat.

title: Calculate purchase costs
